newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY SAYS U.K. LABOUR WIN BOOST TO BIGGER EUROPE.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY SAYS U.K. LABOUR WIN BOOST TO BIGGER EUROPE.

text.p: Hungary said on Tuesday the pro-European stance of Britain's new Labour government should boost EU and NATO accession bids of Hungary and other East European states.

"We believe that this new government in Britain...will play a more active role in the European Union than the previous government, and will be more Europe-oriented than the predecessor government," Foreign Ministry spokesman Gabor Szentivanyi said at a weekly briefing.
Szentivanyi said Britain's taking over the rotating chairmanship of the EU next year, at the end of the EU's Intergovernmental Conference (IGC), could hasten enlargement.
"This is a crucial period of the accession process of the associate member countries, among them Hungary," he said.
"...This British government can of course contribute to the success of the IGC process and thereby create favourable conditions for the enlargement that is to come later."
He said Britain's defeated conservative government had also supported Hungary on NATO and EU enlargement, but added:

"We believe (British Prime Minister) Tony Blair and the foreign policy of this new government will pay at least as much attention to the enlargement of NATO as the previous government so we are very optimistic about this."
